title.zh-CN: 训练集温度与租车量的第一条拟合直线
title.en: The first fitted line for training temperature and rentals

alt.zh-CN: 训练集温度散点与线性回归拟合直线
alt.en: Training temperature scatter plot with a fitted regression line

caption.zh-CN: 直线概括整体上升趋势，但同一温度下租车量仍有很大差异。
caption.en: The line captures the overall rise, while rentals still vary widely at the same temperature.

readingHint.zh-CN: 先沿横轴比较温度，再观察点到直线的垂直距离。
readingHint.en: Compare temperature along the x-axis, then inspect each point's vertical distance to the line.

alt.zh-CN: 训练验证测试时间切分及目标分布直方图
alt.en: Chronological train-validation-test split and target histograms

caption.zh-CN: 三个集合保持时间顺序，后期租车量分布与训练期并不完全相同。
caption.en: The three partitions preserve time order, and later rental counts do not exactly match the training period.

readingHint.zh-CN: 注意验证集不是从训练数据中随机抽出的。
readingHint.en: Notice that validation rows were not randomly sampled from training.

title.zh-CN: 只使用训练集观察特征关系
title.en: Feature relationships inspected on training data only

alt.zh-CN: 温度湿度风速小时与平均租车量的四幅关系图
alt.en: Four relationship plots for temperature, humidity, windspeed, hour and mean rentals

caption.zh-CN: 小时的非线性形状提示单条直线不足以表达通勤节奏。
caption.en: The nonlinear hourly shape suggests one straight effect cannot represent commuting rhythms.

readingHint.zh-CN: 比较散点范围与橙色分组均值线。
readingHint.en: Compare the scatter range with the orange grouped-mean line.

alt.zh-CN: 预测与实际差距以及绝对误差平方误差贡献对比
alt.en: Prediction-to-actual gaps and a comparison of absolute versus squared error contributions

caption.zh-CN: 平方让大残差获得更高权重，因此 MSE 对异常大误差更敏感。
caption.en: Squaring gives large residuals more weight, making MSE more sensitive to extreme errors.

readingHint.zh-CN: 右图已归一化，比较两条曲线的增长速度。
readingHint.en: The right panel is normalized; compare how quickly the two curves grow.

title.zh-CN: 训练集标准化与梯度下降轨迹

alt.zh-CN: 特征标准化前后箱线图与损失梯度轨迹
alt.en: Feature boxplots before and after scaling plus loss and gradient trajectories

caption.zh-CN: 只用训练集拟合缩放参数后，不同特征进入相近数值尺度，优化更稳定。
caption.en: After fitting scaling parameters on training only, features enter comparable ranges and optimization stabilizes.

readingHint.zh-CN: 第三图使用对数坐标，下降后趋平表示接近最小值。
readingHint.en: The third panel uses log scales; flattening after the drop indicates convergence.

title.zh-CN: 小时周期与多项式复杂度

alt.zh-CN: 工作日分时需求曲线与不同多项式次数训练验证误差
alt.en: Hourly demand curves by working day and train-validation errors for polynomial degrees

caption.zh-CN: 特征可以非线性变换，而模型对参数仍保持线性；复杂度必须由验证集检验。
caption.en: Features may be transformed nonlinearly while the model remains linear in its parameters; validation must justify complexity.

readingHint.zh-CN: 左图关注 23 点到 0 点的周期衔接，右图比较训练和验证 RMSE。
readingHint.en: On the left, consider the 23-to-0 boundary; on the right, compare train and validation RMSE.

alt.zh-CN: 六个特征与正则化阶段的训练验证RMSE柱状图
alt.en: Train and validation RMSE bars for six feature and regularization stages

caption.zh-CN: 增加特征通常降低训练误差，但是否值得保留由验证误差和简洁性共同决定。
caption.en: More features often lower training error, but validation performance and simplicity decide whether they stay.

readingHint.zh-CN: 重点比较橙色验证柱，不要只看蓝色训练柱。
readingHint.en: Focus on the orange validation bars rather than only the blue training bars.

title.zh-CN: 条件系数的方向与大小
title.en: Direction and magnitude of conditional coefficients

alt.zh-CN: 标准化连续特征和编码类别特征的系数条形图
alt.en: Coefficient bars for standardized continuous and encoded categorical features

caption.zh-CN: 系数描述其他入模变量保持不变时的条件关联，不能直接解释为因果效应。
caption.en: Coefficients describe conditional associations while other included variables are held fixed; they are not direct causal effects.

readingHint.zh-CN: 先确认特征经过何种缩放或编码，再解释系数。
readingHint.en: Check each feature's scaling or encoding before interpreting its coefficient.

alt.zh-CN: 验证集预测实际对照残差拟合值和分小时残差图
alt.en: Validation prediction-versus-actual, residual-versus-fitted, and hourly residual plots

caption.zh-CN: 残差仍随时段呈现结构，说明线性模型遗漏了部分需求机制。
caption.en: Residuals retain time-of-day structure, showing that the linear model misses part of the demand mechanism.

readingHint.zh-CN: 随机云团较理想；可辨认的弧线或时段偏差表示系统性遗漏。
readingHint.en: A random cloud is preferable; visible curves or hourly bias indicate systematic omissions.

title.zh-CN: 共线性与正则化系数路径

alt.zh-CN: 温度体感温度相关散点及Ridge Lasso系数路径
alt.en: Temperature-apparent-temperature correlation and Ridge/Lasso coefficient paths

caption.zh-CN: temp 与 atemp 高度相关；Ridge 平滑收缩，Lasso 会把部分系数压到零。
caption.en: temp and atemp are highly correlated; Ridge shrinks smoothly while Lasso can drive coefficients to zero.

readingHint.zh-CN: 沿横轴增大 alpha，观察两种方法如何处理相关特征。
readingHint.en: Move right as alpha increases and compare how the methods handle correlated features.

title.zh-CN: 冻结方案后的唯一一次测试集评价
title.en: The single test evaluation after freezing the design

alt.zh-CN: 测试期实际预测时间序列与最终残差分布
alt.en: Test-period actual and predicted time series with the final residual distribution

caption.zh-CN: 测试集只回答冻结方案面对未来时段的表现，不再用于修改特征。
caption.en: The test set only reports how the frozen design handles a later period; it is not used to revise features.

readingHint.zh-CN: 左图只抽样显示以保持可读，指标使用全部 3476 行。
readingHint.en: The left panel is sampled for readability; metrics use all 3,476 rows.
